profile.headline: Lead DevOps/Cloud Engineer | CI/CD Pipeline Implementation | DevOps Automation | Project/Team Leadership
profile.summary: As a solution-focused Lead Engineer, I offer proven results leading the design/development of projects and championing DevOps and Cloud technologies in diverse industries. At the core of my success as a Project/Team Leader and SME is a solid IT foundation, a passion for leveraging cutting-edge tools, and the ability to cross-functionally collaborate across the enterprise to achieve efficient, on-target execution. Throughout my career, I have achieved notable results driving “do it right the first time” execution via cross-collaboration and training/mentoring.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer Azure Platorm DevOps
Lead DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Promoted to a lead DevOps role (60%+ remote) due to performance as a Senior Software Engineer. Assumed additional responsibilities, providing oversight of projects, facilitating decision-making, and indirectly supervising teams of Lead Engineers/Engineers, maintaining a focus on all DevOps functions and activities. Led setup and implementation of infrastructure code integration testing for Chef cookbooks with KitchenCi/Chef InSpec, expanding upon foundational automation of tools/servers as a Senior Software Engineer, and providing a test harness to execute infrastructure code in isolation, reducing errors/downtimes when deploying new infrastructure code.

Partnered with contractor to externalize application configurations using Chef, enabling updating of existing configurations and deployment of new configurations not requiring a new application build. Helped develop the company’s first containerized solution; oversaw setup of CI/CD pipeline in Jenkins for a new line of business utilizing Docker and AWS Elastic Container Registries for deployment to Kubernetes clusters; set up container image vulnerability scanning with Black Duck by Synopsis. Implemented API key system for the Global Content System application using Chef and Apache rewrite rules, limiting access to properly authenticated client applications. Leverage a reputation as a collaborative, improvement-focused, and approachable technical SME to champion the introduction of new technologies, deliver team-wide training, and mentor/guide new and junior personnel.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Recruited to a senior-level role during a companywide transformation/modernization initiative in a newly created role, to co-lead the migration of consumer facing websites for Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental, and Alamo Rent a Car from the internal data center to the cloud and Amazon Web Services. Provided leadership through all project phases, from design and infrastructure development to automation and implementation, with a strong focus on the utilization of DevOps tools and best practices and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Led analysis, design, and implementation of the infrastructure and middleware automation for Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental, and Alamo Rent a Car websites in AWS using Terraform and Chef. Implemented CI/CD pipelines providing a common platform for multiple brands utilizing Node.js applications in Jenkins enabling push button automated builds, deployments and testing. Introduced Liquibase for Enterprise Truck Telematics providing push-button automation and enabling development team to track/version/deploy database schema changes and updates. 

As a Build Engineer, Rental Builds and Configurations, 2005-2006, performed software builds, WebLogic domain configuration, and build/environment troubleshooting supporting development teams. Helped deploy software releases and development of process improvements. Reduced application build times 30% by redesigning structure for rental source code repository to achieve a seamless transition and zero downtime. Decreased build time 20% by redesigning/automating build scripts for department Java applications. Contributions recognized by management.

positions.title: Build and Configuration Management Engineer
positions.description:
Joined a new configuration management team to implement tools/best practices in an agile development environment. Designed and maintained tools/processes supporting application build and source code management; built environment/tools for all Java applications; and automated application deployment framework; implemented Sonar code quality metrics system; and resolved issues in nonproduction environments. Trained and mentored junior personnel. Advanced in 2012 and transitioned to IBM following the acquisition of Silverpop in 2014.

Reduced deployment times 60% by developing/implementing a push-button deployment framework (using Control Tier/Chef) automating all application deployments. Decreased deployment time 25% by developing a software depot using Artifactory and an Apache cache to create a single networked repository for all deployment artifacts. Improved compilation/analysis/reporting of historical code quality data/calculation of Java quality metrics by implementing Sonar code quality platform to continuous integration build system. Automated QuickTest Professional application functional/regression testing to automate build, deployment, testing, and reporting capabilities. Reduced application downtime, redundancies, and configuration variances across multiple applications and releases, working with the architecture team to design a process to generate application configurations using Chef.
